input.title: THE GATE FRAMEWORK — MASTER GATE FILE (Standalone Edition)

accepted_without_material_change: restriction-drop as organizing lens, explicitly not a theorem
atomic proof objects and dependency graphs
separation of exact and deployment checks
gates DOMAIN through COVERAGE as core semantic gates

findings.finding: Primitive, Proven, Open, and Killed are not points on one total warrant ladder. Primitive is a role; Open/Killed are statuses.
findings.repair: Split assumption role, warrant grade, claim status, and reasoning mode into separate fields.

findings.finding: The constitutional rule first says only four grades may be dependencies, then allows explicit Open/Conjecture dependencies.
findings.repair: Use a promotion matrix: unresolved dependencies may appear only as explicit hypotheses; a proved implication is Proven-Modulo, otherwise the dependent claim is capped at Plausible.

findings.finding: UNION_BOUND is omitted from the closed witness list even though the text requires a witness for unions. A union bound does not require disjointness or independence.
findings.repair: Add UNION_BOUND, MONOTONE_ASSEMBLY, and INTERVAL_ARITHMETIC; make witness requirements operation-specific.

findings.finding: The file omits ASSEMBLY, DOMAIN-INFIMUM, and BAND-PROVENANCE, which were made mandatory by frozen C094 failures.
findings.repair: Promote them as gates 14–16 in v1.1.

findings.finding: A single regime-of-validity field records establishment but does not explicitly record the deployment regime being checked.
findings.repair: F-1 becomes an establishment/deployment pair with a named bridge for every mismatch.

findings.finding: Gate 12 cannot be mechanical without instrument IDs, shared components, error-channel declarations, and an independence or external-crosscheck certificate.
Gate 13 cannot be mechanical because the proof object does not carry reasoning mode, load-bearing status, or bridge ID.
findings.repair: Add reasoning-mode, load-bearing, and bridge fields.

findings.finding: Appendix A claims two-case retrodiction for COMMON-MODE and HEURISTIC-BRIDGE but gives no frozen failure IDs or hashes.
findings.repair: Retain both gates provisionally; cap framework-level promotion until a hashed retrodiction table is supplied.

findings.finding: The file says PROVISIONAL caps grade but does not define the cap uniformly.
findings.repair: A provisional gate blocks promotion to Proven/Certified; the claim may remain Derived or Plausible according to the failing gate's explicit cap.

findings.finding: Coverage is not checkable without a declared failure universe, chart family, and uncovered-mass certificate.
Uncertainty side is present, but method, sample size, confidence, multiplicity, algorithmic tolerance, and seed are not.
findings.repair: Add F-3 uncertainty provenance and Gate 16.

findings.finding: COMPOSITION and POLARITY do not recompute a displayed numerical assembly or enforce conservative rounding.
findings.repair: Add F-2 assembly expression and Gate 14.

findings.finding: DOMAIN and ENDPOINT do not prove an infimum/supremum between sampled rungs.
findings.repair: Add a full-domain extremum certificate and Gate 15.

findings.finding: The statement that every threshold must be Derived excludes legitimate normative or user-specified decision thresholds.
findings.repair: Separate theorem/certificate thresholds from policy thresholds; policy thresholds are Primitive-Normative and cannot be cited as mathematical facts.

findings.finding: A content hash is only meaningful if canonical serialization and all load-bearing metadata are included.
findings.repair: Hash canonical proof-object serialization plus dependency hashes.

findings.finding: The file says a missing field is a gate failure but does not define a schema preflight.
findings.repair: Add a mandatory unnumbered SCHEMA preflight before Gate 1.

result: v1.0 is conceptually strong but not sufficient as the executable v5 contract specification. v1.1 is required before successor constants or empirical claims are promoted.
